title: Agent not reporting after install on Ubuntu 22.04
problem: Customer installed nimbus-agent but the host never appeared. Agent log showed NM-1001.
resolution: The host was behind a corporate HTTP proxy. The customer had set HTTPS_PROXY but the agent ignores it. Setting proxy_url in /etc/nimbus/agent.yaml and restarting nimbus-agent fixed it.

title: Data points rejected for Windows hosts
problem: Metrics from several Windows VMs had gaps; agent logged NM-4021.
resolution: Windows Time service was disabled on the VM template, causing clock skew over 60 seconds. Enabling the Windows Time service and restarting NimbusAgent resolved it.

title: Alerts firing during planned database upgrade
problem: Customer got paged repeatedly during a scheduled Postgres upgrade.
resolution: Advised creating a maintenance window scoped to service:postgres for the upgrade period. Monitors keep evaluating but notifications are suppressed. Customer also set up a recurring window via cron for weekly maintenance.

title: HTTP 429 from API during dashboard export script
problem: Customer automation hit 429 errors exporting dashboards.
resolution: Script exceeded 600 requests/minute. Added handling of the Retry-After header and pagination with next_cursor instead of re-requesting. Support also granted a temporary 2x rate limit override for 72 hours while they fixed the script.

title: Webhook payloads rejected by customer endpoint
problem: Customer's endpoint rejected webhooks as unauthenticated.
resolution: Customer was computing the HMAC over the parsed and re-serialized JSON. The X-Nimbus-Signature is computed over the raw request body; verifying against the raw bytes fixed it.

title: EU workspace agents cannot connect
problem: New EU workspace, all agents log NM-1001.
resolution: Agents were configured with the US endpoint ingest.nimbus-monitor.example. EU workspaces must use ingest.eu1.nimbus-monitor.example. Updated the endpoint in agent.yaml.

title: Lost historical data after plan change
problem: Customer downgraded from Team to Free and lost 3 weeks of metrics.
resolution: Expected behaviour: on downgrade, data older than the new plan's retention (7 days for Free) is deleted and cannot be recovered. Explained the policy and offered a trial upgrade; data could not be restored.

title: Slack notifications not arriving in private channel
problem: Monitor messages mention @slack-sre-private but nothing arrives.
resolution: The Nimbus Slack app had not been invited to the private channel. After /invite @Nimbus in the channel, notifications arrived.

title: Kubernetes DaemonSet pods CrashLoopBackOff
problem: After helm install the nimbus-agent pods crash.
resolution: Cluster was running Kubernetes 1.24; the chart requires 1.26 or newer. Customer upgraded the cluster; pods started normally.

title: Too many alert notifications during outage
problem: An AZ outage triggered 300 per-host notifications.
resolution: Enabled Group notifications on the multi-alert monitor so a single notification is sent when many hosts trigger within 5 minutes.

title: Agent upgrade from 2.8 fails
problem: apt upgrade of nimbus-agent from 2.8 to 3.4 fails with a dependency error.
resolution: Agents older than 3.0 cannot be upgraded in place. Uninstalled 2.8 and reinstalled 3.4 using the install script with the same ingestion key.

title: NM-4029 errors from custom metrics
problem: Agent logs payload too large after adding custom metrics.
resolution: Custom metric had a request_id tag creating millions of series. Removed the high-cardinality tag and reduced batch_size; errors stopped.

title: Ingestion backlog for workspace after incident
problem: Customer's dashboards showed data 40 minutes behind after NM-5003 events.
resolution: Checked the Ingestion tab in the admin console; backlog was growing for over 15 minutes. Ran the redrive-partition job for the workspace and the backlog cleared in about 10 minutes.

title: Monitor flapping between OK and ALERT
problem: CPU monitor at 85% threshold flips state every few minutes.
resolution: Added a recovery threshold of 75% and kept a 5 minute evaluation window. Flapping stopped.

title: Customer reports API key posted on public GitHub
problem: Customer accidentally committed a read-write API key to a public repo.
resolution: Followed the restricted security process: force-revoked the key from the admin console, pulled 30 days of audit logs for the security ticket, and paged sec-oncall. No malicious use found.
